product_one_liner.value: Marquee combines football data, club knowledge and proprietary AI to help professional football clubs make recruitment, squad-planning and tactical decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: Marquee describes unifying internal and external football data for professional clubs’ recruitment, squad planning and analytics, using proprietary AI/ML: https://themarquee.ai/news/marquee-raises-6-5-million-seed and https://themarquee.ai/product.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has Product, About, FAQ, News and demo links but no Pricing link: https://themarquee.ai/. The checked /pricing URL returned no readable pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage contains named testimonials from Reading FC and Club Atlético Lanús describing actual staff use of Marquee, rather than merely naming them as partners: https://themarquee.ai/. | named_customers.0: Reading FC’s Head of AI describes staff using Marquee to query data and generate reports: https://themarquee.ai/ and https://themarquee.ai/news/reading-fc-partnership. | named_customers.1: Club Atlético Lanús’s Chief Scout gives a testimonial describing operational use of Marquee: https://themarquee.ai/.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 19 employees, which maps to 11–20. LinkedIn independently displays 19 associated employees, although its broader company-size category is 11–50: https://linkedin.com/company/110819455.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Marquee’s company profile explicitly lists New York, NY as headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/110819455. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as New York and gives a US address: https://linkedin.com/company/themarqueeai.

founded_year.notes: Marquee’s company profile explicitly states Founded 2025: https://linkedin.com/company/110819455.

eng_blog.notes: The news index is predominantly product, partnership and press content: https://themarquee.ai/news. The CTO’s build-or-buy article and the conceptual Squad Fit product/model explainer do not establish two qualifying engineering implementation posts under the requested strict definition. The latter discusses recruitment methodology rather than substantial engineering implementation: https://themarquee.ai/news/half-a-pattern-squad-fit.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link; its only help-oriented destination is the single FAQ page: https://themarquee.ai/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Senior AI Scientist posting has an application option and was updated November 3, 2026: https://devjobs.co.il/job-details/4484676507. The company job board also lists the role: https://devjobs.co.il/company-details/marquee-1.

model_provider.value: Marquee’s 12 proprietary AI/ML models, including Squad Fit, and a purpose-built football LLM.
model_provider.notes: Marquee publicly identifies its own proprietary models and football-specific LLM: https://themarquee.ai/. It also explicitly names its Squad Fit model: https://themarquee.ai/news/half-a-pattern-squad-fit. Claude and ChatGPT are mentioned elsewhere only as general industry examples, not as confirmed product providers.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Marquee states it completed a SOC 2 Type II examination, rather than describing certification as pending: https://themarquee.ai/news/build-or-buy. Only SOC 2 is included. | compliance_certs.0: Marquee explicitly states completion of a SOC 2 Type II examination: https://themarquee.ai/news/build-or-buy.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest round is explicitly identified as seed funding: https://www.finsmes.com/2026/08/marquee-raises-4m-in-seed-funding.html. | funding_date: Marquee’s funding announcement is dated July 30, 2026, giving 2026-07: https://themarquee.ai/news/marquee-raises-6-5-million-seed. The August date on the secondary article is its publication date. | funding_amount_usd: The latest seed round was reported as $4 million; $6.5 million was cumulative funding, not the round amount: https://www.finsmes.com/2026/08/marquee-raises-4m-in-seed-funding.html.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 30, 2026 funding announcement is within the eighteen months before November 9, 2026: https://themarquee.ai/news/marquee-raises-6-5-million-seed.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable company job board shows one open job, Senior AI Scientist, and no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive role: https://devjobs.co.il/company-details/marquee-1.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026, Marquee announced that SkillCorner users could now access their Physical and Game Intelligence data through Marquee. This new integration capability falls within the six-month window: https://themarquee.ai/news/skillcorner-partnership.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Elad Ofer’s profile records a start at Marquee as VP Product in April 2026, within the twelve months before November 9, 2026: https://linkedin.com/in/elad-ofer-617472122.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable Senior AI Scientist posting lists technical requirements and tools but no CRM or sales/marketing system: https://devjobs.co.il/job-details/4484676507. The empty list means none was named in the material inspected, not that Marquee uses no such systems.
